translation:
Harvested on the fifth day of the fifth month, dried in the shade.

Original text of the Benjing: Roucongrong (Cistanche), sweet in flavor, slightly warm. It chiefly treats the five labors and seven injuries, supplements the center, removes cold-heat pain in the penis, nourishes the five viscera, strengthens yin, boosts essence qi, and gives many children; for women,
